taimiaoja.en_lead: A feline powder nutritional supplement containing receptor-binding proteins against feline panleukopenia (FPV), herpesvirus (FHV) and calicivirus (FCV); combined with vitamins to rapidly replenish nutrition, boost immunity and speed recovery.

miaolebao.en_lead: A feline powder containing receptor-binding proteins against FPV, FHV and FCV in easy-to-mix 1.5 g sachets, suited for daily immune support of kittens and picky eaters.
en_usage: Treatment (confirmed or suspected FPV/FHV/FCV): 1 sachet (1.5 g) daily, mixed into food or water (or given directly), for 7–10 consecutive days, used alongside the veterinarian's treatment plan.
Prevention (multi-cat households / catteries / shelters / stress-prone cats): 1 sachet daily for 2 consecutive days each week.

futailai.en_lead: A product with receptor-binding protein against Feline Infectious Peritonitis coronavirus (FCoV), available in both powder and tablet forms. The tablets contain plant-derived herbal antiviral ingredients; administer once daily, one tablet per dose, for 10–15 consecutive days.

en_cases.title: Laboratory treatment observation of oral receptor-binding protein for Feline Infectious Peritonitis (FIP)
en_cases.bg: Cats infected with FIP virus (FIPV); laboratory records show CT value changes before and after treatment in 5 cases: Case 1, low spirits, CT 33.1(+); Case 3, poor appetite and low spirits, CT 31.35(+); Case 4, jaundice and poor appetite, CT 30.96(+); Case 5, abdominal distension (ascitic form), CT 22.75(+).
en_cases.plan: Oral administration of FIP virus receptor-binding protein (FuTaiLai), treatment course of 7–15 doses (compared with 15+ doses for conventional regimens, a short course).
en_cases.eff: After treatment, all 5 cats showed improvement in mental state, appetite and ascites, with CT values turning negative (no CT value) or rising; the data report over 200 cats cumulatively cured, with no relapse after recovery and rapid absorption of ascites.

baozhentai_cat.en_lead: Contains feline herpesvirus receptor-binding protein plus plant-derived herbal antiviral ingredients, targeting ocular and upper-respiratory symptoms caused by feline herpesvirus; administer once daily, one tablet per dose, for 10–15 consecutive days.

en_cases.title: Feline Herpesvirus (FHV) Binding-Protein · Lab Treatment Cases
en_cases.bg: 11 cats positive for feline herpesvirus (numbered 2-1 to 2-17), pre-use CT values 26.11–34.91: 2-1 29.29, 2-2 30.68, 2-3 33.56, 2-7 26.11, 2-17 34.91.
en_cases.plan: BaoZhenTai (feline herpesvirus binding protein) administered for 1 month.
en_cases.eff: Re-tested after 1 month: 2-1 29.29→36.69, 2-2 30.68→39.06, 2-3 33.56→NoCt(-), 2-4 32.12→NoCt(-), 2-5 29.16→NoCt(-), 2-6 28.05→NoCt(-), 2-7 26.11→NoCt(-), 2-8 NoCt(-)→NoCt(-), 2-12 NoCt(-)→NoCt(-), 2-17 34.91→NoCt(-); most cats turned CT-negative or showed a clear rise.

beizhuangtai.en_lead: Contains feline calicivirus receptor-binding protein plus plant-derived herbal antiviral ingredients; given orally, 1–2 tablets, for 10–15 consecutive days, targeting oral and respiratory symptoms caused by feline calicivirus.

wentailai.en_lead: Contains feline panleukopenia virus receptor-binding protein plus plant-derived herbal antiviral ingredients, targeting feline panleukopenia (FPV); administer once daily, one tablet per dose, for 10–15 consecutive days.
en_usage: Directions: once daily, one tablet per dose, for 10–15 consecutive days (feline tablets containing feline panleukopenia virus receptor-binding protein plus plant-derived herbal antiviral ingredients).

yanzhengtai.en_lead: A topical spray for both cats and dogs, containing broad-spectrum antimicrobial protein plus epidermal growth factor (EGF) and fibroblast growth factor (FGF21); suitable for topical use on skin injuries, oral ulcers and surgical wounds.

taiwangja.en_lead: A canine powder containing receptor-binding proteins against canine distemper, canine parvovirus and canine coronavirus, combined with vitamins to rapidly replenish nutrition, boost immunity and speed recovery.

wanglebao.en_lead: A canine powder nutritional supplement containing receptor-binding proteins against canine distemper, canine parvovirus and canine coronavirus; 2 g sachets are easy to mix into food, suited for puppies and post-illness recovery.

xinaowei.en_lead: The safest live Newcastle disease (ND) vaccine (safe for day-old squabs), naturally heat-tolerant with an ICPI of zero, manufactured by Jiujiang Bomeilai Biological Products Co., Ltd.

xinsian.en_lead: Antigen content 5× the standard, immunity enhancer boosted by 100%, manufactured by Jiujiang Bomeilai Biological Products Co., Ltd.

xinliu.en_lead: Up to 94.4% protection against the H9 subtype; administered by subcutaneous (neck) or intramuscular (under-wing) injection, a single immunization protects simultaneously against Newcastle disease and avian influenza H9.
en_usage: Subcutaneous (neck) / intramuscular (under-wing) injection (inactivated bivalent vaccine for Newcastle disease + avian influenza H9 subtype, 500 ml/bottle, La Sota strain + WD strain, up to 94.4% protection against H9 subtype).

baotai_pigeon.en_lead: Efficient expression of endogenous interferon with an innovative encapsulation process; one bottle ideally treats 2,000 birds, providing long-lasting protection of over 60 days.
en_usage: Mix into drinking water or feed; one bottle ideally treats 2,000 birds (Vitamin Premix I, 5 g/bottle; immune activation, >60-day long-lasting protection, efficient endogenous interferon expression).

qintaining.en_lead: Subcutaneous (neck) or intramuscular (breast) injection at 0.2 ml/bird; can be mixed with oil-adjuvant vaccines, targeting drug-resistant bacteria with broad-spectrum antibacterial action and no drug residue.
en_usage: Subcutaneous (neck) or intramuscular (breast) injection at 0.2 ml/bird; can be mixed with oil-adjuvant vaccines (Liquid Vitamin Premix IV; effective against drug-resistant bacteria, broad-spectrum antibacterial, no residue).

en_cases.title: QinTaiNing (antimicrobial protein) animal efficacy study — challenge protection test against Mycoplasma synoviae (MS)
en_cases.bg: Strain: Mycoplasma synoviae (MS); test animals: 5–7-day-old chicks.
en_cases.plan: Injected QinTaiNing (oil emulsion) at 0.2 ml; 24 hours later challenged with Mycoplasma.
en_cases.eff: Recorded as a challenge protection test; the source did not provide specific protection-rate data.

qintai_pigeon.en_lead: A broad-spectrum, general-purpose vitamin premix with direct action, efficient combination and no stress residue; a foundational product for pigeon nutrition and immune support.
en_usage: Administered via feed mixing or drinking water to reduce stress; gastric-passage technology prevents active ingredients from degrading, enabling targeted release and absorption in the intestine.

Oral use for 7 days markedly reduces mortality (prevention-focused: monitor CT values rising or turning negative; flocks recover, feed intake rebounds, and regular prevention prevents outbreaks); a biological preparation, non-toxic with no drug residue.

taikang.en_lead: A pigeon-specific vitamin premix; 1 kg treats 2,400–3,000 birds via drinking water or feed for 2 consecutive days, made with an innovative process and premium raw materials.
en_usage: 1 kg treats 2,400–3,000 birds via drinking water or feed for 2 consecutive days (avian vitamin premix, 1 kg).

nanhuaweikang.en_lead: A compound vitamin B soluble powder for multiple neuritis, digestive disorders and pellagra-related stomatitis; dissolve 0.5–1.5 g per 1 L of drinking water, used for 3–5 consecutive days.
en_usage: Dissolve in drinking water: 0.5–1.5 g per 1 L of water, for 3–5 consecutive days (compound vitamin B soluble powder, 1000 g; for vitamin B deficiency, multiple neuritis, digestive disorders, pellagra-related stomatitis).

wutan.en_lead: Broad-spectrum disinfectant effective against bacterial spores, fungi and viruses; suitable for farm and hatching-egg disinfection; routine dilution 1:2000–4000, outbreak-period dilution 1:500–1000.
en_usage: Routine dilution 1:2000–4000; outbreak-period dilution 1:500–1000 (glutaraldehyde-deciquam solution, 1000 g; for broad-spectrum farm/hatching-egg disinfection against bacterial spores, fungi and viruses).

dikang.en_lead: A dimetridazole premix, antiprotozoal and broad-spectrum antibacterial, targeting Treponema and Histomonas; veterinary prescription drug, 400–2500 g per 1000 kg of feed.
en_usage: 400–2500 g per 1000 kg of feed (HaiTai DiKang, dimetridazole premix, 100 g; antiprotozoal, broad-spectrum antibacterial, for Treponema and Histomonas).

koufu.en_lead: An electrolyte supplement that regulates acid-base balance, for heat stress and diarrhea correction; dissolve 1 sachet in 4 L of water for ad libitum drinking.
en_usage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 4 L of water for ad libitum drinking (oral rehydration salt, 118 g; electrolyte supplement for acid-base balance, heat stress and diarrhea correction).

hongtailai.en_lead: A viral receptor-binding protein product targeting ranavirus iridovirus (RSIV) in mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) and sea bass. Administered orally in feed for 5–7 consecutive days; clinical observations show markedly reduced mortality and viral clearance.
en_usage: Take 1 pack of Pack A, add to approx. 600 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.
Mix thoroughly and evenly with 20 kg of feed.
Take 1 pack of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 600 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.
Add to the above 20 kg of feed and mix thoroughly and evenly to complete the coating.
Feed one meal per day for 5–7 consecutive days.

en_cases.title: Foshan fish farm: 30,000 mandarin fish · RSIV outbreak
en_cases.bg: A mandarin fish farm hit by ranavirus iridovirus; before using HongTaiLai, approx. 300 fish died per day.
en_cases.plan: Administered orally in feed for 7 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: By day 15, mortality dropped to 6 fish per day, and the ranavirus iridovirus disease was effectively controlled.

en_cases.title: Sea Bass · Iridovirus (RSIV), CT 30.18
en_cases.bg: RSIV-infected sea bass (CT 30.18), split into two equal groups under identical husbandry.
en_cases.plan: Trial group fed iridovirus binding-protein-coated feed, one meal daily for 5 consecutive days; tested after 7 days of observation.
en_cases.eff: Trial group turned PCR-negative (CT ≥45) with average survival 65%; control remained positive (CT 31.668) with survival 35%.

en_cases.title: Sea Bass · Iridovirus (RSIV), High-Dose Group
en_cases.bg: RSIV-infected sea bass, split into two equal groups.
en_cases.plan: Trial group fed iridovirus binding-protein-coated feed, one meal daily for 5 consecutive days; tested after 5 days of observation.
en_cases.eff: Trial group turned PCR-negative (CT ≥45) with average survival 90%; control remained positive (CT 37.34) with survival 68%.

shentailai.en_lead: A viral receptor-binding protein product targeting nervous necrosis virus (NNV) in grouper and mandarin fish. NNV challenge-protection trials showed significantly higher survival in the treatment group versus the control.
en_usage: Take 1 pack of Pack A, add to approx. 600 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.
Mix thoroughly and evenly with 20 kg of feed.
Take 1 pack of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 600 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.
Add to the above 20 kg of feed and mix thoroughly and evenly to complete the coating.
Feed one meal per day for 5–7 consecutive days.

en_cases.title: Dongying, Shandong: 15,000 grouper · NNV challenge
en_cases.bg: Nervous necrosis virus positive, over 100 fish dying per day.
en_cases.plan: Administered ShenTaiLai orally in feed for 7 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: By day 12, mortality dropped to 0 fish per day, and the nervous necrosis virus disease was effectively controlled.

en_cases.title: Mandarin fish · challenge test
en_cases.bg: Feed-fed mandarin fish challenged with NNV, with a control group and a treatment group of 30 fish each, all intramuscularly injected with NNV.
en_cases.plan: The treatment group received NNV receptor-binding protein orally in feed for 5 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: Mortality in the treatment group was significantly lower than in the control group; survival at 5 days was higher than the control, demonstrating significant protection.

en_cases.title: Grouper · Iridovirus Disease
en_cases.bg: Iridovirus disease outbreak at a grouper farm.
en_cases.plan: ShenTaiLai (binding protein) administered continuously.
en_cases.eff: Disease brought under effective control in clinical observation.

zhongtailai.en_lead: A viral receptor-binding protein product targeting infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) in mandarin fish. Clinical case: PCR-strong-positive mandarin fish fed orally for 5 consecutive days showed zero mortality by day 8 and negative nucleic-acid test.
en_usage: Take 1 pack of Pack A, add to approx. 600 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.
Mix thoroughly and evenly with 20 kg of feed.
Take 1 pack of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 600 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.
Add to the above 20 kg of feed and mix thoroughly and evenly to complete the coating.
Feed one meal per day for 5–7 consecutive days.

en_cases.title: Shunde, Foshan: 10,000 feed-fed mandarin fish · ISKNV strongly positive
en_cases.bg: PCR strongly positive (CT value approx. 10), approx. 60 fish dying per day.
en_cases.plan: Administered ZhongTaiLai orally in feed for 5 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: By day 8, mortality reached zero and ISKNV nucleic-acid test was negative.

en_cases.title: Mandarin Fish · ISKNV Oral-Subunit-Vaccine Challenge
en_cases.bg: Immunized-challenge group (ISKNV subunit, two oral immunizations) + challenge-control group, 30 fish each, both intramuscularly injected with ISKNV.
en_cases.plan: ISKNV subunit oral vaccine administered as continuous immunization.
en_cases.eff: Cumulative mortality reached 100% in challenge-control by day 9, and 50% in immunized-challenge group by day 12; disease then brought under effective control.

en_cases.title: Foshan 6.6-mu Mandarin Fish Pond · ISKNV Outbreak
en_cases.bg: A 6.6-mu feed-fed mandarin fish farm in Foshan, Guangdong; ISKNV-positive with rapidly rising mortality.
en_cases.plan: From day 7, one meal daily with ISKNV binding-protein feed for 7 consecutive days, plus 4 additional days of supplementary feeding.
en_cases.eff: By day 26 mortality dropped to zero and ISKNV nucleic-acid test turned negative.

dantailai.en_lead: A fish viral receptor-binding protein product that enhances immunity and supports antiviral defense, suited for prevention and recovery of various fish viral diseases.
en_usage: Take 1 pack of Pack A, add to approx. 600 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.
Mix thoroughly and evenly with 20 kg of feed.
Take 1 pack of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 600 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.
Add to the above 20 kg of feed and mix thoroughly and evenly to complete the coating.
Feed one meal per day for 5–7 consecutive days.

yubaotai.en_lead: Florfenicol powder (aquaculture use) for nocardiosis in snakehead fish (Channa argus); a veterinary prescription drug. Proprietary reverse-encapsulation technology reduces resistant-bacteria development.
en_usage: Take 100 g of this product, mix thoroughly with 300 ml of vegetable oil, then use to coat 20 kg of fish feed.
Use this product for 3–7 consecutive days.
Prepared medicated feed should not be left standing for long.
Avoid long-term use at high doses.
This product is for fish feed additive use only.

en_cases.title: Yangchun: 20,000 snakehead fish · nocardiosis
en_cases.bg: 250 g per fish, nocardiosis outbreak, 130–150 fish dying per day; conventional antibiotics ineffective.
en_cases.plan: YuBaoTai, 2 packs daily mixed into 80 jin of feed.
en_cases.eff: By the sixth day, the bacterial disease was largely under control.

baozhentai_fish.en_lead: A fish herpesvirus receptor-binding protein product that enhances immunity and supports antiviral defense, suited for prevention and control of fish herpesvirus-related disease.
en_usage: Take 1 pack of Pack A, add to approx. 600 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.

Take 1 pack of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 600 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.

en_cases.title: BaoZhenTai / tilapia (fish herpesvirus)
en_cases.bg: Tilapia farming scenario.
en_cases.plan: Used BaoZhenTai (fish herpesvirus receptor-binding protein, Compound Premix VI).
en_cases.eff: Effectively controlled (case library records 1 tilapia case; plus 3 related cases of soft-shell turtle / tilapia / grass carp).

watailei.en_lead: A ranavirus receptor-binding protein product targeting bullfrog 'wry-neck disease' (Flavobacterium brain-nerve infection). Controlled trials showed a survival rate of approx. 75% (vs. approx. 44% in controls).
en_usage: Take 2 packs of WaTaiLei Pack A (500 g), add to approx. 1200 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.
Mix thoroughly and evenly with 20 kg of frog feed.
Take 2 packs of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 1200 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.
Add to the above 20 kg of feed and mix thoroughly and evenly to complete the coating.

Recommended to start at the small four-legged tadpole stage: first feeding for 3 consecutive days, one meal per day; after a one-month interval, feed once more for 3 consecutive days, one meal per day.

en_cases.title: Controlled trial across 3 bullfrog farms (20,000 each)
en_cases.bg: Typical symptoms of bullfrog wry-neck disease (Flavobacterium): some frogs with head tilt and swimming imbalance.
en_cases.plan: WaTaiLei (ranavirus receptor-binding protein) fed mixed into feed per instructions.
en_cases.eff: WaTaiLei group survival rates approx. 75% / 73% / 76%; mortality/culling rate reduced by approx. 50% versus controls.

en_cases.title: Chenghai Bullfrog Farm · Wry-neck Disease Prevention
en_cases.bg: Two adjacent ponds, 100,000 frogs each, under identical farming conditions.
en_cases.plan: Trial group: 2 packs WaTaiLei + 600 ml vegetable oil mixed with 20 kg feed, one meal daily for 3 consecutive days; repeat once after one month (3 days).
en_cases.eff: Within 14 days after second immunization: trial group cumulative deaths 2,033 vs control 2,526 — a 24.3% reduction in mortality.

en_cases.title: Jiangmen Bullfrog Farm · Survival Improvement
en_cases.bg: A Jiangmen bullfrog farm, 40,000 juvenile bullfrogs; trial vs control, 20,000 each, in 100 m² net pens.
en_cases.plan: Trial group started at juvenile stage: 3 consecutive days in first month, 3 consecutive days in second month, one meal daily.
en_cases.eff: Survival 75% (trial) vs 60% (control); feed cost saved ¥3,824 per pen, sales increased ¥9,520, ROI ≈ 11.9×.

en_cases.title: Hainan Wanning Bullfrog Farm · Skin Ulcer Disease
en_cases.bg: A Wanning, Hainan bullfrog farm, 58,000 juvenile bullfrogs; trial vs control, 29,000 each, in 140 m² earthen ponds with flow-through water.
en_cases.plan: Trial group: 2 packs over first month (5 days) + 4 packs over second month (3 days), total 6 packs.
en_cases.eff: After 1 month: mortality 2.17% (trial) vs 2.60% (control); trial frogs had glossier skin, fewer skin-ulcer cases, smaller individual variation and higher uniformity.

wabaotai.en_lead: An aquaculture antibiotic for acute bacterial disease in bullfrogs, with proprietary reverse-encapsulation technology that reduces water pollution and resistant-bacteria development. First choice for acute outbreaks and severe cases; can be combined with WaTaiLei.
en_usage: Take 100 g of this product, mix thoroughly with 300 ml of vegetable oil, then use to coat 20 kg of frog feed.
Use this product for 3–7 consecutive days.
Prepared medicated feed should not be left standing for long.
Avoid long-term use at high doses.
This product is for frog feed additive use only.

en_cases.title: Chaozhou, Guangdong bullfrog farm · bacterial disease outbreak
en_cases.bg: Bacterial disease outbreak, 260–380 frogs dying per day; conventional antibiotics ineffective.
en_cases.plan: Switched to WaBaoTai mixed into feed.
en_cases.eff: Rapidly reduced daily mortality; the bacterial disease was brought under control.

wataida.en_lead: For bullfrog red-leg, skin erosion and gastroenteritis caused by Aeromonas, Streptococcus, etc.; 250 g large pack to eliminate red-leg, gastroenteritis and skin erosion.
en_usage: Take 2 packs of WaTaiDa Pack A, add to approx. 1200 ml water while stirring, and mix thoroughly into a suspension.
Mix thoroughly and evenly with 20 kg of frog feed.
Take 2 packs of Pack B (coating material), dissolve in approx. 1200 ml water, adding while stirring until fully dissolved.

en_cases.bg: Shrimp farming scenario.
en_cases.plan: Used HuTaiLai (shrimp Vibrio adhesion protein with natural plant and herbal bactericidal factors).
en_cases.eff: Effectively controlled (the shrimp case collection records 2 HuTaiLai shrimp Vibrio cases).

baotailai.en_lead: An adhesion-protein product targeting shrimp Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP); usable in both prevention and treatment scenarios, with marked clearance at low parasite loads.

en_cases.title: Zhongshan shrimp · Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP) · within 10⁴
en_cases.bg: Shrimp EHP load within 10⁴ (4th power).
en_cases.plan: Administered BaoTaiLai orally in feed for 7–8 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: After 7–8 days, EHP load in shrimp was essentially cleared, with markedly improved feed intake and vitality.

en_cases.title: Zhuhai shrimp · treatment scenario
en_cases.bg: Mid-to-late stage of EHP infection.
en_cases.plan: Dose calculated by body weight, fed continuously.
en_cases.eff: Parasite load dropped significantly versus pre-treatment, and feed intake and vitality gradually recovered.

en_cases.title: Jiangsu small-shed shrimp · prevention program
en_cases.bg: High stocking density and high disease pressure.
en_cases.plan: Regular preventive feeding after stocking.
en_cases.eff: Infection rate significantly lower than controls; overall farming success rate improved.

xiahongtai.en_lead: A receptor-binding protein product targeting iridovirus in white shrimp and giant river prawn (Macrobrachium rosenbergii), boosting immunity for antibiotic-free farming.

en_cases.title: XiaHongTai / white shrimp iridovirus (Zhuhai white-shrimp joint trial site)
en_cases.bg: Initial iridovirus load 4.244×10³ UI/ml.
en_cases.plan: Used shrimp iridovirus (ranavirus) receptor-binding protein (XiaHongTai) for 7 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: Re-sampling showed the iridovirus load in pond shrimp cleared to zero (4.244×10³ → 0 UI/ml; cleared in 7 days).

en_cases.title: XiaHongTai / giant river prawn iridovirus
en_cases.bg: Giant river prawn initially tested strongly positive for iridovirus.
en_cases.plan: Used shrimp iridovirus (ranavirus) receptor-binding protein (XiaHongTai) for 7 consecutive days.
en_cases.eff: Re-test of iridovirus in pond giant river prawns was negative (strongly positive → negative).

qinbaotai.en_lead: An avian vitamin premix that overcomes immune suppression, activates the immune system and provides >60-day long-lasting protection while lowering mortality/culling rate. First dose at 1–3 days of age, repeated at 7–10 days of age.
en_usage: First dose at 1–3 days of age, repeated at 7–10 days of age (QinBaoTai, Vitamin Premix I (avian), 200 g · 1000 bird-doses/bottle; overcomes immune suppression, >60-day long-lasting protection).

xubaotai.en_lead: A livestock vitamin premix that overcomes immune suppression, prevents diarrhea and protects growth, with >60-day long-lasting protection. Piglets: 20 head-doses/bottle; sows: 10 head-doses/bottle. First course 3–7 consecutive days, then once every two months.
en_usage: Piglets: 20 head-doses/bottle; sows: 10 head-doses/bottle; calves: 10 head-doses/bottle; cows: 5 head-doses/bottle.

First course 3–7 consecutive days, then once every two months (XuBaoTai, Vitamin Premix (livestock); overcomes immune suppression, prevents diarrhea and protects growth, >60-day long-lasting protection).
